description: Generate a video from a video template (additive; CONSUMES API quota). Async: returns a `pending` video whose uid you poll with bannerbear_get_video (video_url populates on completion). API: POST /v2/videos.

input_media_url.description: URL of the source media (e.g. an audio/video file) to build from.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata string echoed back on the object.

modifications.description: Layer overrides applied to the template. Array of objects, one per layer, each keyed by `name` (the layer name) plus the props to set, e.g. { name: "title", text: "Hello", color: "#FF0000" } or { name: "photo", image_url: "https://..." }. Only include layers you want to change.

webhook_url.description: URL Bannerbear will POST the finished video to when done.

name: bannerbear_create_video
title: Create video
